grammar_title: 被动语态综合复习(各时态被动 + 非谓语被动 + 主动/被动选择)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修四 Unit 2 Using language: Review passive voice。三个分点各20题,每题靠时间标志/句法环境只成立一种形式;干扰项是错时态或错语态;零术语、纯应用;句子围绕《相约星期二》与人生主题。

points.point: 一般时态被动(is/was/will be done,看时间标志判断)
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动:现在 is/are done、过去 was/were done、将来 will be done;由句中时间标志(today/nowadays、last week/ago/in 1997、tomorrow/next year 等)决定时态;主动形式因主语不发出动作而排除。

points.point: 完成/进行时态被动(has been done · is being done · had been done)
points.overview: 现在完成被动 has/have been done(already/so far/since);过去完成被动 had been done(by the time…、by 1997);现在进行被动 is/are being done(right now/look!);过去进行被动 was/were being done(while…、when… came)。靠标志选一种。

points.point: 非谓语被动 + 情态被动 + 主动/被动选择(to be done · being done · must be done)
points.overview: need/want/ask + to be done;介词(despite/after/without/by)+ being done;情态 must/should/can/will + be done;再由主语是施动者还是承受者,在主动与被动之间作选择。

questions.stem: Nowadays, Morrie's lessons ____ by readers around the world.
questions.explanation: 时间标志 Nowadays 指现在、主语 lessons 是被分享的对象 → 一般现在被动 are shared。

questions.stem: The very first review of the book ____ by a journalist back in 1997.
questions.explanation: back in 1997 指过去、review 被写 → 一般过去被动 was written。

questions.stem: A new film about the book ____ next year.
questions.explanation: next year 指将来、film 被拍 → 一般将来被动 will be made。

questions.stem: Today this moving novel ____ in many school libraries.
questions.explanation: Today 指现在、novel 被找到/陈列 → 一般现在被动 is found。

questions.stem: Mitch ____ deeply by his old teacher's courage last winter.
questions.explanation: last winter 指过去、Mitch 被打动 → 一般过去被动 was moved。

questions.stem: These study notes ____ to the new students tomorrow.
questions.explanation: tomorrow 指将来、notes 被发放 → 一般将来被动 will be given。

questions.stem: Every week, fresh flowers ____ to Morrie's room by his students.
questions.explanation: Every week 表示现在的习惯、flowers 被送来 → 一般现在被动 are brought。

questions.stem: The old photograph ____ on the wall years ago.
questions.explanation: years ago 指过去、photograph 被挂 → 一般过去被动 was hung。

questions.stem: The professor's wisdom ____ down to future readers one day.
questions.explanation: one day 指将来、wisdom 被传递 → 一般将来被动 will be passed。

questions.stem: At present, the book ____ into more than thirty languages.
questions.explanation: At present 指现在、book 被翻译 → 一般现在被动 is translated。

questions.stem: His final lecture ____ by the whole class yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 指过去、lecture 被录下 → 一般过去被动 was recorded。

questions.stem: A special edition of the novel ____ this coming spring.
questions.explanation: this coming spring 指将来、edition 被印刷 → 一般将来被动 will be printed。

questions.stem: These days, a few kind words ____ more than expensive gifts.
questions.explanation: These days 指现在、words 被珍视 → 一般现在被动 are valued。

questions.stem: The interview with Morrie ____ on the radio last night.
questions.explanation: last night 指过去、interview 被播出 → 一般过去被动 was broadcast。

questions.stem: Many copies of the book ____ to the charity sale next week.
questions.explanation: next week 指将来、copies 被捐赠 → 一般将来被动 will be donated。

questions.stem: Usually the book club's choice ____ by all the members together.
questions.explanation: Usually 表示现在的习惯、choice 被决定 → 一般现在被动 is made。

questions.stem: Morrie ____ to hospital two years ago when his illness grew worse.
questions.explanation: two years ago 指过去、Morrie 被送 → 一般过去被动 was taken。

questions.stem: The new reading list ____ to parents this coming weekend.
questions.explanation: this coming weekend 指将来、list 被发送 → 一般将来被动 will be sent。

questions.stem: Generally, his gentle advice ____ by people of all ages.
questions.explanation: Generally 表示一般情况(现在)、advice 被遵循 → 一般现在被动 is followed。

questions.stem: That famous course ____ by Professor Schwartz for many years before he retired.
questions.explanation: before he retired 指过去、course 被讲授 → 一般过去被动 was taught。

questions.stem: So far, the book ____ into more than forty languages.
questions.explanation: So far 与现在相连 → 现在完成被动 has been translated。

questions.stem: Right now, a new cover ____ for the next edition.
questions.explanation: Right now 表示此刻正在 → 现在进行被动 is being designed。

questions.stem: By the time Mitch came in, the lesson ____.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去动作,之前已完成 → 过去完成被动 had been finished。

questions.stem: When the nurse entered, Morrie ____ gently by his wife.
questions.explanation: 过去某动作发生时正在进行 → 过去进行被动 was being helped。

questions.stem: Morrie's story ____ on the evening news already.
questions.explanation: already 与现在相连 → 现在完成被动 has been shown。

questions.stem: Look! The old lecture hall ____ for the memorial.
questions.explanation: Look! 表示此刻正在 → 现在进行被动 is being decorated。

questions.stem: Mitch realised that the manuscript ____ before the deadline.
questions.explanation: 过去 realised 之前更早完成 → 过去完成被动 had been completed。

questions.stem: Up to now, thousands of warm letters ____ to the author.
questions.explanation: Up to now 与现在相连 → 现在完成被动 have been sent。

questions.stem: While the interview ____, the telephone suddenly rang.
questions.explanation: While + 过去正在进行 → 过去进行被动 was being recorded。

questions.stem: At the moment, a documentary about Morrie ____.
questions.explanation: At the moment 表示此刻正在 → 现在进行被动 is being filmed。

questions.stem: The novel ____ widely since it first appeared.
questions.explanation: since + 过去到现在 → 现在完成被动 has been read。

questions.stem: By 1997, the book ____ by millions of readers.
questions.explanation: By 1997(过去时间点之前)→ 过去完成被动 had been bought。

questions.stem: Currently, his ideas about life ____ in many classrooms.
questions.explanation: Currently 表示此刻正在 → 现在进行被动 are being discussed。

questions.stem: When Mitch knocked at the door, Morrie ____ to a softer chair.
questions.explanation: 过去某动作发生时正被搬动 → 过去进行被动 was being moved。

questions.stem: Recently, the play of the story ____ in several theatres.
questions.explanation: Recently 与现在相连 → 现在完成被动 has been performed。

questions.stem: The old man told us his garden ____ long before he fell ill.
questions.explanation: 比过去 fell ill 更早完成 → 过去完成被动 had been planted。

questions.stem: Right now, the final chapter ____ aloud to the whole class.
questions.explanation: Right now 表示此刻正在 → 现在进行被动 is being read。

questions.stem: So far, the message of love ____ by many young readers.
questions.explanation: So far 与现在相连 → 现在完成被动 has been understood。

questions.stem: At that moment yesterday, the meeting room ____ for the visitors.
questions.explanation: At that moment yesterday(过去某刻正在)→ 过去进行被动 was being cleaned。

questions.stem: Before the bell rang, all the homework ____ in.
questions.explanation: 比过去 rang 更早完成 → 过去完成被动 had been handed。

questions.stem: Such important life lessons need ____ on to the young.
questions.explanation: need + 不定式被动,lessons 是被传递的对象 → to be passed。

questions.stem: Despite ____ by a serious illness, Morrie stayed cheerful.
questions.explanation: 介词 Despite 后接动名词、Morrie 被削弱 → being weakened。

questions.stem: A box of tissues will ____ to get through this moving book.
questions.explanation: will + 情态/将来被动,tissues 被需要 → be needed。

questions.stem: Every Tuesday, Mitch ____ his old professor at his house.
questions.explanation: 主语 Mitch 是探望的发出者 → 用主动 visited。

questions.stem: The kind old professor ____ by Mitch every Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 主语 professor 是被探望的对象、有 by Mitch → 用被动 was visited。

questions.stem: These values are too personal ____ by anyone else.
questions.explanation: too…to + 被动不定式,values 被决定 → to be decided。

questions.stem: After ____ widely by critics, the novel became a bestseller.
questions.explanation: 介词 After 后接动名词、novel 被评论 → being reviewed。

questions.stem: Your own values must ____ by yourself, not by society.
questions.explanation: 情态 must + 被动,values 被选择 → be chosen。

questions.stem: From his window, Morrie ____ everything as though through new eyes.
questions.explanation: 主语 Morrie 是观察的发出者 → 用主动 observed。

questions.stem: Mitch wanted his teacher's wisdom ____ down for others.
questions.explanation: want + 宾语 + 不定式被动,wisdom 被记录 → to be recorded。

questions.stem: Without ____ properly, the book's message can easily be missed.
questions.explanation: 介词 Without 后接动名词、message 被解释 → being explained。

questions.stem: Such a moving story should ____ by everyone at least once.
questions.explanation: 情态 should + 被动(by everyone),story 被读 → be read。

questions.stem: The whole book ____ in less than a year by a grateful student.
questions.explanation: 主语 book 是被写的对象、有 by…→ 用被动 was written。

questions.stem: Mitch ____ the story so that others could learn from Morrie.
questions.explanation: 主语 Mitch 是写作的发出者 → 用主动 wrote。

questions.stem: Important truths can ____ even in the shortest of stories.
questions.explanation: 情态 can + 被动,truths 被发现 → be found。

questions.stem: Near the end, the dying man asked ____ closer to the window.
questions.explanation: ask + 不定式被动,他被移动 → to be moved。

questions.stem: By ____ by a wise teacher, we slowly learn how to live.
questions.explanation: 介词 By 后接动名词、we 被引导 → being guided。

questions.stem: Such quiet bravery may never ____ by those who read the book.
questions.explanation: 情态 may + 被动,bravery 被遗忘 → be forgotten。

questions.stem: Old friendships deserve ____ alive with a few warm words.
questions.explanation: deserve + 不定式被动,friendships 被保持 → to be kept。

questions.stem: Great respect ____ to Morrie by all of his former students.
questions.explanation: 主语 respect 是被给予的对象、有 by…→ 用被动 was given。
